name: Slides Studio
description: A hand-built HTML slide deck with a live preview while you work

actions.label: One idea per slide
actions.prompt: Walk the deck slide by slide. Any slide carrying more than one idea gets split; any slide that's a wall of text gets cut to its point. Keep the total flow intact. Edit the deck directly.

actions.label: Draft speaker notes
actions.prompt: For each slide, write or refresh its speaker notes in an <aside class="notes"> inside the section: what to actually say, 2-4 sentences, conversational. Don't restate the slide text.
